verdict.rationale: Letta explicitly documents self-hosting: 'Letta agents can run entirely on infrastructure you control' and a self-hosted App Server that hosts agents on infrastructure you own, and the project is described as fully open source. This directly satisfies the platform-engineer's self-host/deploy-on-own-infra need, though the pack lacks explicit Docker-specific instructions or independent hands-on confirmation of a successful self-hosted deployment. Missing for 10: explicit Docker/container deployment docs, independent/community confirmation of self-hosting success.
